title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Reforming and Improving the Management of the Publication of Court Announcements
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Reforming and Improving the Management of the Publication of Court Announcements

Fa [2023] No. 244

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to standardize the management of the publication of court announcements, the Supreme People's Court issued the "Provisions on Further Standardizing the Management of the Publication of Court Announcements (Trial)" (Fa [2020] No. 242, hereinafter referred to as Document No. 242) on September 15, 2020. From the perspective of actual operation since then, the timeliness and standardization of the publication of court announcements have been greatly improved. However, problems such as long publication cycles, narrow audience coverage, and insufficient standardization still exist, and are sometimes quite prominent, hindering the smooth progress of trial and enforcement work and affecting the proper exercise of the litigation rights of the parties. In order to thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, earnestly practice the people-centered development philosophy, deepen and solidify the work of serving the overall situation and delivering justice for the people, actively respond to the new requirements and expectations of the people for judicial work, ensure that the fruits of the reform of the people's courts truly benefit the people, and strive to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case, the Supreme People's Court has decided to further improve and standardize the management of the publication of court announcements in the implementation of Document No. 242 by the courts. The relevant requirements are hereby notified as follows.

1. The publication of court announcements will be fully digitalized. From January 1, 2024, except for statutory types of court announcements that must be published in newspapers, the People's Court Daily will no longer publish court announcements. All court announcements will be published on the China Court Network (sub-site: People's Court Announcement Network). Announcements published on the China Court Network and the People's Court Daily will also be simultaneously pushed to well-known online media platforms, enabling instant forwarding, rapid dissemination, and convenient access to court announcements. Other media publishing court announcements shall, in principle, also publish them through online platforms.

2. Court announcements must be strictly limited to publication in "newspapers, information networks, and other media with nationwide reach and influence." Article 5 of Document No. 242 provides that the media publishing announcements shall, in principle, be "newspapers, information networks, and other media with nationwide reach and influence." After deliberation, it is determined that the major newspapers and their major online media platforms of 18 central key news organizations (including People's Daily, Xinhua News Agency, China Media Group, Qiushi Journal, PLA News Media Center, Guangming Daily, Economic Daily, China Daily, Science and Technology Daily, CPPCC Daily, News and Communication Center of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Commission of Supervision, China News Service, Study Times, Workers' Daily, China Youth Daily, China Women's News, Farmers' Daily, and Legal Daily) and 3 central political and legal news organizations (People's Court News Media Group, Procuratorate Daily, and the News Media Center of the Ministry of Public Security) are designated as "newspapers, information networks, and other media with nationwide reach and influence." The major newspapers and their major online media platforms of the above-mentioned "18+3" entities shall be the media platforms for publishing court announcements. People's courts shall not publish court announcements on other media platforms.

3. The case handling systems of people's courts at all levels shall be connected to the Announcement Management System of the People's Court News Media Group. People's courts at all levels shall proactively establish a direct interface between their case handling systems and the Announcement Management System of the People's Court News Media Group, to achieve two-way flow of court announcement data, so that announcement information can be comprehensively, accurately, and timely returned and aggregated, ensuring that case handlers can directly and smoothly process, publish, retrieve, and preserve announcements within the case handling system, and actively leveraging the role of announcement data in serving trial and enforcement work.

4. Standardized assessment and management shall be strengthened. Document No. 242 is the basic regulation for standardizing the management of the publication of court announcements. People's courts at all levels shall strictly implement the provisions of Document No. 242, incorporate the publication of announcements into trial process management for assessment, strengthen daily supervision and inspection, and ensure that the requirements of Document No. 242 are implemented and enforced. People's courts at all levels shall review whether the media's publication of announcements is standardized. For media that violate the requirements for announcement publication and refuse to correct after being pointed out, announcements shall no longer be published through such media, so as to ensure the standardization, timeliness, and authoritativeness of announcement publication.

5. Other requirements. Each High People's Court shall promptly communicate the spirit of this notice to the people's courts within its jurisdiction, and shall earnestly implement it in light of actual circumstances, pay attention to summarizing experience, and improve and perfect relevant working mechanisms. Any problems or suggestions encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court.

December 27, 2023
